meta.description: A native iOS app for a beauty booking platform for Afro-American women in Canada: discover salons and stylists, choose a service and a time, and get reminded before the appointment.

intro.name: Viktor Nešić
intro.offer: Viktor Nešić is a senior mobile developer building native iOS, Android and Kotlin Multiplatform apps with Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. Available for freelance and contract projects, working remotely.

caseStudy.title: Sliike
caseStudy.lead: A native iOS app for a beauty booking platform for Afro-American women in Canada: discover salons and stylists, choose a service and a time, and get reminded before the appointment.

brief.title: The brief
text: Sliike connects Afro-American women with salons and stylists who specialise in their hair and beauty. The first version was to be a native iOS app built from the client's Figma designs.

contributions.title: What I did
items: Built the native iOS app in Swift and UIKit from the Figma designs.
Implemented discovering salons and stylists, choosing a service and booking a time.
Worked with the client through the native iOS phase of the product.

team.title: Team
team.text: I built the app myself, working directly with the client.

outcome.title: The result
outcome.text: The client later chose a cross-platform framework to cover Android as well, and the project continued without me after the native iOS phase.

cta.title: Have a project like this?
cta.text: I build and rescue native iOS, Android and Kotlin Multiplatform apps, and I'm happy to look at yours.
